svg.title: Nobody threat-models the merge driver, and it runs code on my runner
svg.desc: A git merge driver script wired to a runner, with an open backdoor arrow from a PR branch into the runner's environment. Trace Bloom generative banner for “Nobody threat-models the merge driver, and it runs code on my runner”. A isometric lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 3783178400.
